description: This file defines a custom exception class ADODB_Exception for handling database error exceptions in the ADOdb library, along with a function adodb_throw that throws exceptions based on database errors.

classes.name: ADODB_Exception
classes.description: A custom exception class extending PHP's base Exception class, used for database error handling in the ADOdb library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for ADODB_Exception, initializes the exception with detailed database error information.
